#DataScience | #MLOps | #EnterpriseTech  
Hi there! I’m Kunal, a data scientist at GlobalTech Solutions, where I focus on turning complex data into actionable insights. Over the past three years, I’ve worked on projects that blend analytics with real-world business needs—whether it’s optimizing supply chains or refining customer segmentation strategies.  

My day-to-day involves a mix of Python, Spark, and some heavy lifting with Pandas and NumPy. I’ve built data pipelines that process millions of records daily, and I’ve modeled datasets to uncover patterns that drive decision-making. Visualizing these insights with Plotly and Matplotlib has been key to making data accessible to non-technical teams.  

MLOps is a big part of my workflow too. I’ve deployed models using MLflow, ensuring they stay reliable and scalable. When I’m not coding, I’m usually diving into new tools or refining existing ones to make workflows smoother.  

I’m always curious about how data can solve real problems, and I enjoy collaborating with teams to turn ideas into impact. Let’s connect if you’re navigating similar challenges—happy to share stories or insights! 🚀
